featured_reviews.name: Sree
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best culinary experiences I’ve had in Mumbai. I stumbled upon this spot tucked into one of the city’s busiest, most crowded streets, and it was absolutely worth navigating the chaos to get there.

I ordered the pav bhaji and chole bhature, and both were outstanding. The pav bhaji was rich, buttery, and perfectly spiced with that authentic street-style flavor, yet it felt clean and hygienic. The chole bhature was just as impressive — fluffy, hot bhature paired with chole that had deep, balanced masala without being overly oily. You could taste the freshness in every bite.

What really elevated the experience was the staff. I was new to Mumbai and a bit overwhelmed, but they were incredibly friendly and patient. They took the time to explain the menu, recommend what to try, and even shared how each dish is traditionally eaten. At no point did I feel rushed despite the constant crowd outside.

I also noticed how neat and well-maintained the place was. For a busy street-side eatery, the tables were clean, the serving area was organized, and the staff did not feel rushed.

Great food, warm service, and surprising neatness in the heart of Mumbai’s bustle. I’ll definitely be back. Highly recommended if you want authentic flavors without compromising on hygiene

featured_reviews.review_text:
"Prabhu Pure Veg" in Masjid Bunder, Mumbai, is a well-established vegetarian restaurant with a history dating back to 1944. It's known for its economical pricing, convenient location near Masjid Bunder Railway Station, and a variety of pure vegetarian dishes.
Here's a detailed review based on common feedback:
Overall Experience:
Prabhu Pure Veg generally receives positive reviews for its value for money and tasty, hygienic food. It's a popular spot for locals and those seeking a quick, satisfying vegetarian meal in the bustling Masjid Bunder area. While not a fine-dining establishment, it serves its purpose as a reliable and budget-friendly option.
Food Quality and Variety:
* Taste: The food is consistently praised for being delicious and well-prepared. Many reviewers highlight the good quality and reasonable rates.
* Specialties: While specific "must-try" dishes aren't overwhelmingly mentioned, items like Ghee Podi Idli, Batata Wada, and Lemon Grass Tea have been positively noted. Their menu is described as extensive, covering various vegetarian preparations from local and potentially global influences. South Indian, North Indian, and Street Food options are commonly available.
* Hygiene: The restaurant is generally considered to maintain good hygiene standards, which is a significant factor for many diners.
* Ingredients: The focus is on using quality ingredients from trusted suppliers, which contributes to the overall taste and freshness of the dishes.
Pricing:
* Economical: One of Prabhu Pure Veg's strongest points is its affordability. With an average price for two around ₹450, it's considered very budget-friendly, especially for the portion sizes and quality offered.
Service:
* Mixed Reviews: Service can be a mixed bag. While some reviews mention prompt and good service, others specifically point out slow service and long wait times, particularly during peak hours. This seems to be an area where improvement is often suggested.
* Staff: Some reviews note the staff as polite and well-mannered.
Ambience:
* Casual and Functional: Prabhu Pure Veg is a casual dining restaurant. It's not typically known for its elaborate ambiance but rather for being a functional place to grab a quick meal. It can get crowded, especially due to its popularity and location.
* Presentation: While the ambiance might be simple, some reviewers appreciate the presentation of the food itself.
Location:
* Convenient: Its proximity to Masjid Bunder Railway Station ticket bridge and Bhaat Bazar makes it easily accessible for commuters and shoppers in the area.
Things to Consider:
* Wait Times: Be prepared for potential wait times, especially if visiting during busy hours.
* Simple Ambiance: Don't expect a luxurious or fancy dining experience. It's more of a no-frills, focus-on-the-food kind of place.
* Crowds: Due to its popularity and location, it can be quite busy and noisy.
In Summary:
Prabhu Pure Veg is a highly recommended spot for those looking for economical, tasty, and hygienic pure vegetarian food in the Masjid Bunder area of Mumbai. It's a no-frills establishment that prioritizes good food at affordable prices, making it a local favorite. While service speed can sometimes be an issue, the overall positive feedback on food quality and value makes it a worthwhile visit for any vegetarian food enthusiast.

featured_reviews.name: ReservedSeat
featured_reviews.review_text:
If there's anything that fits well in my new year's weight loss resolution it's Flax! Our major hunt for healthy resturants got us to this place and we decided to give it a try.

What we had:
The Burrito Bowl: Honestly this is the most generous of bowls we've ever tried. A mix of leaves, corn, tomatoes and onions, generous portions of brown rice with kidney and black beans. This bowl is ideally enough for one person and also so so delicious!!!

The Whole Grain Pasta Salad: Again, portion wise great and the pasta with leaves, paneer, flax seed tossed in pesto sauce! If only all salads could be this tasty!

Hummus and Grilled Paneer Wrap: The best of the lot! We absolutely loved this wrapped goodness! Lots of salad, great seasoning, hummus and paneer, the combination tasting so good together! This is a definite must have!

Sundried Tomato Hummus with Lavash - Delicious hummus, so creamy and definition high up on health with whole grain lavash! So yum!

With so many healthy options to choose from, Flax totally is gonna be our go to option for food that's healthy and delicious too.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Pravin Master
featured_reviews.review_text:
This the first outlet of Flax which was opened in 2016. Super impress with the quality of food and the service. All the fresh ingredients are used for making the items. If you are looking for a healthy option and a diet change, this is sure a must-visit/order place.

I have tried the Burrito bowl which is a High protein meal. I loved the combination and taste.

Hummus and grilled Paneer Wrap is also tastily made with a stuffing of Grilled Paneer, Onion, Tomato, Cucumber, Jalapeno, and Red pepper Hummus.

Whole Grain Pasta salad has a really super yummy, with the pesto dressing, It’s just perfect.
A wide range of Cold-pressed juice is also available for healthy alternatives.

featured_reviews.name: Aishwarya Shrikhande
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited this place yesterday to try their healthy menu. I loved their Moroccan Super bowl, the honey vanilla yogurt and the dressing. This place is located in one corner of the floor and is very conjusted. It has place for just 2 people to sit and have their food. I feel for this outlet it is better to do a take away or order online.

featured_reviews.name: Piyush Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Flax as name itself indicates towards healthy living, this food chain too are working on health related feeds only.

We have ordered yesterday for our lunch rather than eating the oily stuff in our office and even though place is at gud distance from my place, delivery is well on time.

We have ordered the following:
Whole grain Pasta Salad: Immunity booster they call it, whole wheat fussili with pesto dressing along with lot of veggies like Arugula, spinach, corn, paneer etc was amazing and in gud quantity.

So Thai Bowl : Another healthy variant with Lots of veggies like spinach, Arugula, peanuts ,Papaya along with red rice , if eaten plainly not gud but with addition of Thai sauce given along with it, a little sour and tangy, is making it a must try bowl.

Spiced Paneer Wrap: A wheat wrap stuffing of spinach, soft paneer sponge up in salsa , jalapenos, feta cheese is delicious.

Moreover, we also had beetroot hummus with ragi crackers as side order complimenting it totally.

We also had juice like Apple, orange celery one - basic, healthy and tasty stuff.
Another one is neutralizer : So Coconut water as base used to neutralize any acids of your body with a touch of mint and hint of lemon.

Overall we 3 were able to complete our lunch and stuffed totally. Great experience and would love to have stuff from these guys on my fasting days.....😉😉😉

featured_reviews.name: Puneet Arya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited the Flax Breach Candy outlet for tasting their new salads. It is located inside the Nitro Gym building.

Tried Mediterranean Salad, Pad Thai Crunch Salad, Sunshine Salad, Jain Tokyo Bowl and I Love You Berry Much Smoothie.

The food seems to be very light on the stomach.

The smoothie I Love You Berry Much is a good alternative for a dessert and this contains honey instead of sugar.

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Flax is one of the go to place to have healthy food and beverages. You would not regret your decision of ordering from here because the food looks attractive and it is 100 percent nutritious and wholesome.

You can get some lipsmacking bowls, salads and wraps at your doorstep. The presentation of the food will leave you amazed and the dips given alongside the bowls make the whole meal more salubrious.

Things we ordered:

☑️Power Booster Salad: A salad with some vital nutrients. Grilled chicken with veggies and mustard dressing. A power packed salad very good for a person who is on a diet and needs a healthy start to his meal.

☑️Chipotle Cowboy Bowl: A wholesome meal with Salsa sauce and tangy- spicy Jalapeno and mango dressing. It also has guacamole a dip made of avacado. With some good content of veggies like spinach, onions, arugula,corn, mixed beans and ragi chips. Last but not the least grilled chicken.

☑️Spiced Indian Chicken Wrap: A wrap with wheat flour tortilla. Loaded with chicken and a delectable dish apt for lunch and dinner.

☑️Greek Mango Yoghurt: A Calcium boost for your diet to have it as a dessert or a quick snack. Can be enjoyed any time of the day and this will leave you awestruck.

featured_reviews.name: Ayush Bhandari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Flax is being the healthiest food destination next to the nitrro gym on the basement floor of Hubtown skyway in Breach candy area.
They serve a wide range of salads in an exceptionally tastiest way ever. Though seating is not much spacious, pickup is available with proper packing ensured. They serve there own packed smoothies as well as yoghurts. Jain preparations available.

In Superbowl section we ordered The Burrito bowl which had arugala, corn, onion and tomatoes with beans, brown rice served with Greek yoghurt.

In signature salads we had Veggie keto salad which was an exceptional salad i have ever had with a surprising combination of almond and walnut with veggies garnished with coconut flakes served with tahina yoghurt .

featured_reviews.name: Yatin Diwan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Healthy Food - Good and Fresh Food for the body and soul.

I am a regular customer of Flax. They have varieties of healthy salad, burrito bowl and smoothie.

I had ordered The Burrito Bowl (High Protein, Vitamin C) and Nutri Boost Smoothie. I really enjoyed my food. The Burrito bowl had rich Sprouts and Celery.

The test was nice, food quality was good, food ingredients were fresh and healthy.

Regarding price, well considering the quantity I found the price to be bit above reasonable range.

I highly recommend the Dal Lasoony - it's rich, creamy, and packed with flavor. The ghee chapatis were perfectly soft and fluffy.

The portions are generous (enough for two with average appetites).

While it's a bit pricey (₹₹₹), the quality and taste definitely make it worth it.

Be aware that the restaurant is small with limited seating and gets quite crowded. Thankfully, they have AC to keep things comfortable.

The staff are super efficient and friendly, providing quick service even when busy.

Important Note:  There are other restaurants with similar names, so make sure you find the one with "Shree G" in the name to get the authentic experience.
Overall: Delicious food, great service, and a must-try for vegetarians in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: Stringzzz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shree Thaker Bhojnalaya – A Timeless Taste of Authentic Gujarati Thali

Shree Thaker Bhojnalaya is one of the most iconic and beloved places to experience authentic Gujarati cuisine. Known for its traditional thali, warm hospitality, and consistent quality, this legendary eatery has earned a special place in the hearts of locals as well as visitors. Dining here feels less like eating at a restaurant and more like being welcomed into a Gujarati household.

The moment you enter Shree Thaker Bhojnalaya, you are greeted with simplicity and warmth. The interiors are modest, clean, and functional, reflecting the traditional values of Gujarati culture where food quality and hospitality matter more than luxury décor. The seating arrangement is organized, and despite the heavy rush during peak hours, the staff manages the crowd efficiently.

The highlight, without any doubt, is the Gujarati Thali. The thali is a wholesome and balanced meal that represents the true essence of Gujarat’s culinary heritage. It usually includes a variety of rotating dishes such as shaak (vegetable curries), kadhi, dal, rotli or puri, rice, khichdi, farsan, chutneys, pickles, and traditional sweets like shrikhand or mohanthal. Each item is freshly prepared and served hot.

One of the most impressive aspects of Shree Thaker Bhojnalaya is the unlimited serving system. The staff continuously serves food with great attentiveness, ensuring that guests never feel rushed or restricted. The flavors are authentic—mildly spiced, well-balanced, and comforting—making the food suitable for all age groups. The use of fresh ingredients and traditional cooking methods is clearly reflected in the taste.

Historically, Shree Thaker Bhojnalaya has been serving Gujarati food for decades and is considered a cultural landmark. It has preserved the original style of Gujarati dining, where meals are meant to nourish both the body and the soul. Many regular visitors associate the place with nostalgia, family gatherings, and cultural pride.

Cleanliness and hygiene are well maintained throughout the restaurant. Plates, serving areas, and dining spaces are kept tidy, even during peak hours. The staff is polite, disciplined, and well trained, adding to the overall pleasant dining experience.

The pricing is reasonable, especially considering the quality, quantity, and authenticity of the food served. It offers excellent value for money and is often recommended as a must-visit place for anyone wanting to experience true Gujarati cuisine.

Shree Thaker Bhojnalaya attracts a diverse crowd—families, elderly guests, tourists, and food lovers from across India. Despite the popularity and long waiting times during weekends, the management ensures smooth operations and quick table turnover without compromising service quality.

Overall, Shree Thaker Bhojnalaya is not just a restaurant but a celebration of Gujarati tradition, flavors, and hospitality. If you want to experience a soulful Gujarati thali prepared with authenticity and served with warmth, this place is an absolute must-visit. It leaves you with a satisfied heart, a happy stomach, and a deep appreciation for Gujarat’s rich culinary culture.

The Tex Mex Classic Burger was a highlight, with a crispy potato patty paired beautifully with black beans, cheese sauce, fresh salsa, guacamole, and pickled onions—every bite had a nice balance of textures and flavors.

It’s something you don’t come across often and definitely worth trying.

For drinks, the Mango Inferno stood out with its sweet and spicy combination, especially with that bold hit of red chillies. The Jalamelon was equally refreshing—juicy watermelon with a hint of jalapeños giving it a nice kick.

Ended the meal with the Quattro Leche dessert, a rich and indulgent take on the classic three-milk dessert, and it was the perfect way to wrap things up.

On top of the food, the place offers comfortable indoor as well as outdoor seating, making it ideal for both casual hangouts and relaxed dining. Overall, a well-rounded experience with good food, interesting flavors, and a chill vibe.

Their bottled beverages, like the Fizzarito and Lymang Magic, are incredibly refreshing and serve as the perfect palate cleanser between spicy bites.
Final Verdict
Whether you’re looking for a quick takeaway or a cute spot for a casual date night, this place is a solid choice. Great portions, vibrant atmosphere, and authentic flavors.

​This is a vegetarian restaurant, but they could not make even the basic dishes taste good. Here is what we ordered:
​Dal Fry: They served us a cold, tasteless yellow liquid. It had no flavor at all. I had to send it back to the kitchen and ask them to heat it up and add a proper tadka (spices) to it.
​Pav Bhaji: The bhaji was bad and It just tasted like a lot of raw garam masala. It was way too spicy and ruined our taste.

featured_reviews.name: Adv. Kalpesh ojha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sukh Sagar is conveniently located just a 2-minute walk from Girgaon Chowpatty. We visited on a Saturday evening and had to wait about 10 minutes for a table, which was reasonable given the crowd.

We ordered dosa, uttapam, pizza, and pav bhaji. Unfortunately, the food didn’t meet our expectations. My mother felt the pav bhaji lacked flavor—as the saying goes, “unchi dukan, fiki pakwan” (big shop, bland food). Having tried authentic South Indian cuisine in Chennai and Kerala, I found Sukh Sagar’s dosa and uttapam fell short of that standard. The only dish that impressed us was the pizza.

The prices seemed quite high considering the taste and quality of the food. My mother, a senior citizen and excellent cook herself, jokingly remarked that she could prepare better food at home!

We will never come to this restaurant again.

featured_reviews.name: Queen Bee
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Sukh Sagar for dinner in October 2025. While the food quality was excellent and we truly enjoyed the meal, there were a few significant drawbacks to the experience.
First, the pricing felt excessively high for the value provided. For instance, a single bottle of mineral water was priced at ₹50, which is considerably above the market rate. Second, the cleanliness of the seating area was disappointing. The seat covers appeared unwashed and were visibly dirty, suggesting they had not been cleaned recently.
On a positive note, the service was good and the staff was attentive. However, for a restaurant at this price point, I expected a much higher standard of hygiene and more reasonable pricing for basic items.

featured_reviews.name: Vedansh dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
A good place to visit, especially for a late-night outing. The atmosphere is lively and energetic, though the menu options can be somewhat limited at that hour. We tried the pizza, which leaned more towards a desi style and felt a bit pricey for what it offered.

On the positive side, the seating space is comfortable, service is quick, and the staff maintains a friendly vibe. Overall, it’s a decent spot to hang out, though there’s room for improvement in terms of variety and value for money.
